Communio. Frumentum Chri- sti s"; accents, ae/oe ligatures and word division differ throughout; the antecedent reading is an optical text layer and its pointing cannot be trusted at comma level. propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Refecti participatione muneris sacri, quaesumus, Domine Deus noster: ut,
cujus exsequimur cultum, intercedente beato Ignatio Martyre tuo atque
Pontifice, sentiamus effectum. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium
tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti Deus: per omnia
saecula saeculorum. R. Amen.

translations.caution: Original study translation; not approved for liturgical use or recitation.
translations.text:
Nourished by sharing in the sacred gift, we ask, Lord our God, that, through the intercession of blessed Ignatius, your martyr and bishop, we may experience the effect of what we celebrate in worship. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God for ever and ever.
R. Amen.
